name: EIMT

about.text: European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) is one of the prestigious institutes offering a wide range of courses in business management and technology. It was established in Switzerland and presently it has several campuses in France and Switzerland. It supports On-Campus as well as Online bachelor, master’s, and doctorate programs. EIMT offers a transformative learning experience and top-quality education with the integration of advanced technology to create a favorable academic environment.

All the undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctorate programs at the European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) are supported by esteemed faculty members with significant expertise and experience. These faculty members are committed to shaping the future of the students with extraordinary education with real-world experiences. Students are encouraged to acquire advanced skills and competencies for their holistic development in leadership roles in global industries.

The European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) has approvals and accreditations from eminent institutions and government bodies. It has 2-year accreditation from the Diplomatic Research and Policy Foundation (DRPF) which is a government-recognized Accreditation Agency. The International Association for Quality Assurance in Pre-Tertiary & Higher Education (QAHE) has also fully accredited EIMT. Apart from accreditation, EIMT is also a member of distinguished education bodies. It is a member of the Accreditation Council for Business Schools and Programs (ACBSP) and a full member of the European Association of Institutions in Higher Education (EURASHE). It is also a member of the United States Distance Learning Association (USDLA). These memberships and accreditations present EIMT as a top-grade academic institution.

EIMT offers excellent student support with a dynamic team of student support services that is committed to cater the needs of every student enrolled in any program. Regardless of their learning modes, all the students are entitled to the student's support services. Students also get access to well well-established global community. This provides them with diverse opportunities to make connections that are beneficial for personal and professional growth. By meeting the highest educational benchmarks, EIMT prepares students to lead in fast-paced globally emerging industries.

aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

facts: EIMT is based in Switzerland and France, with multiple campuses offering top-quality education and providing students with an international learning environment with access to flexible education opportunities.
EIMT offers more than 20 degree programs, including bachelor’s, master’s, doctoral, diploma, and certificate programs across different fields of study.

Individuals can pursue their program as per their convenience in terms of Online, on-campus, and blended formats. This setup allows the learners to choose the study method that best suits their professional and personal needs.

emi.text: European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) ensures that every student enrolled in the institute can pay the course fees easily. To enable students with this, EIMT offers part-time tuition fee loans to the students apart from the affordable fee structure. With this facility, students will be able to pay their tuition fees in easy installments. Moreover, students can also seek other financial assistance and scholarships to lower their burden of fee payments.

admission.text: Candidates interested in admission to the European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) can easily secure a seat by following the admission process mentioned below-
Choose the Program: Begin the admission process by selecting the appropriate program you want to pursue at the European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT).

Go Through the Eligibility Requirements: Once you have selected the appropriate program, it is advisable to go through the eligibility requirements for the particular program. Make sure you meet all the eligibility requirements for the program.

Prepare all the Documents: Once you have gone through the eligibility requirements, prepare and get ready with all the necessary documents. You may need to be ready with academic transcripts, a CV or resume, proof of language proficiency, letters of recommendation, and a statement of purpose based on your program.

Complete the Application Form: After getting ready with all the necessary documents, visit the official website of the European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) to fill out and submit the application form. Make sure all the information is filled in correctly as any wrong information may lead to the rejection of the application.

Review of Application: Once the application form has been successfully submitted, EIMT will go through the application form to ensure that it meets all the eligibility requirements. If your application meets all the requirements you will be called for an interview as a part of the verification process.

Application Interview: EIMT will invite you for an application interview to learn about you in a better way. Generally, the interview is either conducted over a Phone Call or Video Call. The institute will try to know about your plans and understand the reason you are interested in a particular program.

Payment of fees: If the EIMT is satisfied with your application and interview, it will initiate your admission confirmation by sending you the invoice for the first-year fees. You can secure a seat in EIMT by paying the first-year fees. Post payment of your tuition fees, you will get a payment receipt.
Start the Program: Once you have paid the first-year course fees, you can start your degree at EIMT.

examination.text: The examination at the European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) is conducted based on the mode of delivery. For on-campus programs, students are required to appear at the examination center of EIMT whereas, for Online Courses, examinations are conducted remotely. Students are evaluated based on their performance in written examinations, assignments, and project works at the bachelor's and master’s levels. For Doctorate programs, students are evaluated based on their comprehensive examinations, Thesis /Dissertation, and Viva Voice.

placementText.text: The wide global recognition and high-quality education, the European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) attracts top global companies and business organizations for the placement and hiring of its students. The Institute has good connections with some of the apex employers in the industry. EIMT ensures that all students are enrolled in its various programs before completion of their degree. Here is the list of some of the top recruiters that hired students from the European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) - Apple, Microsoft, Google, Morgan Stanly, Amazon, American Express, Deloitte, JP Morgan Chase, Nvidia, Meta, Berkshire Hathaway, etc.

faqs.q: What are the memberships of the European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT)?
faqs.a: The European Institute of Management & Technology (EIMT) is a full member of the European Association of Institutions in Higher Education (EURASHE. It is also a member of the Accreditation Council for Business Schools and Programs (ACBSP), OTHM United Kingdom, and the United States Distance Learning Association (USDLA).
